text:
ashok: Creating action queue from the postmortem for the 3/21 GPU surge. Main buckets: quota limits, scheduler tuning, headroom modelling. Comment to claim an item. I’ll drop initial TODOs below.
ops-bot: Automated note: postmortem doc stored at https://docs.redwood.ai/postmortems/2026-03-21-gpu-surge — please link JIRA.
maria: I’ll take quota followups. Will audit tenant reservations and quota backstop. ETA Tue EOD.
devon: I’ll own scheduler tuning experiments: gap metrics, preemption thresholds. Nice-to-have: run simulation harness. Putting a card on the capacity board.
liz: Headroom planning — I can run demand forecast and propose headroom targets per region. Need example traffic slices from infra.
ashok: Assigning provisional owners: quota -> maria, scheduler -> devon, headroom -> liz. @kevin can you assist with infra templates and runbooks?
kevin: Happy to help. I’ll prep autoscale policy diffs and a quick runbook for emergency backfills.
maria: Quick note: the tenant that caused the spike had an unexpected training job with bursty IO. Filing a JIRA now: RW-4821 and linking logs.
devon: Experiment plan (sketch): ```yaml
pipeline:
  - simulate_burst: 1000qps
  - measure_p95: true
  - vary_batching: [1,4,8]
``` I’ll run baseline by Wednesday.
liz: Suggest we add a recurring RPM check — monthly headroom sanity test across regions. If agreed I’ll schedule.
ashok: :eyes: Good. Next steps: owners add JIRA tickets, estimate effort in days, set target completion dates. I’ll consolidate into a single tracking board and ping PM for prioritization. Please update by EOD Friday.
maria: :thumbsup: filing tickets and adding notes about quota backstop thresholds.
ops-bot: Reminder: create JIRA label `capacity-action` and add #eng-sre reviewers.
devon: If folks want the scheduler sim, ping me — I’ll share a docker image and a small dataset.
liz: Added a first-cut headroom table to the postmortem doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/handbooks/headroom-templates — feedback welcome.
kevin: I’ll draft a short emergency runbook snippet we can attach to RW-4821.
ashok: Thanks everyone — we’ll reconvene in 1 week for a short status sync and to close any quick wins.
